entities.name: Agent
entities.definition: A specialized AI actor with defined permissions and responsibilities

entities.name: Mission
entities.definition: A unit of work assigned to one or more agents

entities.name: Factory
entities.definition: A production unit with one mission, one responsibility, one owner, one validation, one output

entities.name: Artefact
entities.definition: A certified output produced by a Factory

entities.name: Gate
entities.definition: A quality control checkpoint in factory execution

entities.name: Knowledge
entities.definition: Structured information about the system, its concepts, and their relationships

entities.name: Memory
entities.definition: Persistent state preserving continuity across sessions

entities.name: Proof
entities.definition: Validated evidence supporting a claim or assertion

entities.name: Decision
entities.definition: An executive choice that directs factory operations

entities.name: Twin
entities.definition: A digital representation of a system, process, or person

entities.name: Workspace
entities.definition: A managed view of the file system with index and governance

entities.name: Runtime
entities.definition: The execution environment of the SUPRA application
